welcome.title: Welcome to PowerMeter
welcome.body: PowerMeter passively reads Aion 2 combat data and shows your DPS, skills and fight history in an in-game overlay and in this dashboard.
req.title: System check
req.body: PowerMeter needs these to capture combat data. This list refreshes every 2 seconds.
req.npcapHint: Install Npcap with “WinPcap API-compatible Mode” enabled.
req.adminHint: Close PowerMeter and start it again with “Run as administrator”.
req.gameHint: Optional: you can start the game later.
req.blocked: Npcap and administrator rights are required to continue.
char.title: Your character
char.body: The character name is also detected automatically from the game window title.
char.name: Character name
char.nameHint: Optional. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
account.title: Discord account
account.body: Signing in with Discord to upload logs and share builds arrives in the next version.
disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.body: PowerMeter is an unofficial tool, not affiliated with NCSoft. It passively reads combat data. Use it at your own risk.
status.waitingHint: Aion 2 is running. The meter locks on as soon as it sees game traffic.
status.connectedHint: The meter is capturing combat data.
status.errorHint: Could not read the meter status.
